description: instagram: Posts. GET /v2/instagram/user/posts. Get the first 12 posts on a public profile's grid (reels, photos, videos and carousels): code, URL, media type, caption, display image and date, with the user. Only the first 12 are available signed out: next_max_id is always null and passing one returns 400; more_available says whether the profile has more. Like, comment and play counts are not in the signed-out grid; /v1/instagram/user/reels has counts for reels an Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

handle.description: The Instagram username, with or without @

next_max_id.description: Not supported: signed-out pagination is closed, so only the first 12 posts are returned. Passing one returns 400.

require_play_counts.description: Accepted for compatibility and ignored: the signed-out grid has no counts.

trim.description: Set to true for a trimmed response.

name: instagram_user_posts
